claims.text: The FDA sufentanil label says opioids with alcohol may cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.
claims.quote: Concomitant use of opioids with benzodiazepines or other central nervous ‎system (CNS) depressants, including ‎alcohol, may result in profound sedation, ‎respiratory depression, coma, and death.

headline.text: The FDA sufentanil label links alcohol co-use to profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

reported.text: The label's opioid warning explicitly includes alcohol among CNS depressants.

gaps.text: The packet contains no human study of this combination.
searched: (ethanol[tiab] OR alcohol[tiab]) AND "sufentanil"[tiab] AND (interaction OR coadministration)
